claim_text: Low intake of selected vitamin A-rich foods does not by itself diagnose vitamin A deficiency; total dietary sources, fortified foods, life stage and clinical context should be assessed before supplementation.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support evidence-based nutrient assessment and avoid automatic supplementation.

population.other_context: People reporting low intake of vitamin A-rich foods.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food and/or supplemental sources; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin A fact sheet describes food sources, reference values and safety considerations.
limitations: Avoid high-dose preformed vitamin A, particularly in pregnancy; no dose from this claim.
Exact source passages and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
